mapper.select: SELECT id, fund_code, fund_name, category, nav, risk_level FROM mutual_funds WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, fund_code, fund_name, category, nav, risk_level FROM mutual_funds WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode}
SELECT id, fund_code, fund_name, category, nav, risk_level FROM mutual_funds ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.user_id, i.fund_id, i.units, i.invested_amount, i.current_value, i.investment_type, i.status, i.invested_at, mf.fund_name, mf.fund_code, mf.nav FROM investments i JOIN mutual_funds mf ON i.fund_id = mf.id WHERE i.id = #{id}

SELECT i.id, i.user_id, i.fund_id, i.units, i.invested_amount, i.current_value, i.investment_type, i.status, i.invested_at, mf.fund_name, mf.fund_code, mf.nav FROM investments i JOIN mutual_funds mf ON i.fund_id = mf.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.invested_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investments (user_id, fund_id, units, invested_amount, current_value, investment_type, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fundId}, #{units}, #{investedAmount}, #{currentValue}, #{investmentType}, #{status})
